baseEligibilityBanner: Some existing modifiers could not be identified; blocking may be incomplete.
unionCoverageDisclaimer: Branch coverage only — this is not a probability.
unknownInteraction: This interaction is not verified yet. The overlay will not guess the modifier pool.
dataStale: Crafting data may be outdated for the current PoE2 patch.
copyMissed: No item was copied. Hover an item in the game (the game window must be active, the item not covered by the overlay) and press {{hotkey}} again.
showBaseIneligible: Show modifiers this base cannot roll
rowsTruncated: Showing {{shown}} of {{count}} modifiers. Use the search or filters to see the rest.
chooseCurrency: Choose a currency to see the modifiers you can get.
basePoolNote: The item's current modifiers are not taken into account.
copyItemHint: Copy an item in game (Ctrl+Alt+C), then press {{hotkey}}.

categoryHint.regular: Modifiers this base can also roll through ordinary crafting.
categoryHint.exclusive: Modifiers available only through Desecration; ordinary crafting cannot roll them.

slotsRecognizedOnly: Counted from the recognized modifiers; a hidden Desecrated modifier may not be included.
slotsUndetermined: The free slots of this item cannot be determined.
previewPick: Click a modifier in the list to see it on the item.
openSideOnly: Filter: {{side}} — only this side has a free slot. Whether Desecration can also replace a modifier on the full side is not confirmed yet.

explain.minModifierLevel: revealed modifiers are at least level {{level}}

forceSide.prefix: the new modifier will be a prefix
forceSide.suffix: the new modifier will be a suffix

explain.putrefaction: replaces the item's modifiers with Unrevealed Desecrated modifiers and corrupts the item
explain.revealReroll: reroll the reveal options {{count}}× when revealing
explain.annulDesecratedOnly: the next {{currency}} removes only a Desecrated modifier
